name: school-courses
description: Cursos de colegio (primaria y secundaria) con lecciones cortas, quizzes, repaso espaciado y simulacros: sitio estático y app de escritorio

scripts.dist: node scripts/build.mjs && node platform/build/icons.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/build.mjs && node platform/build/icons.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/build.mjs && node platform/build/icons.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/build.mjs && node platform/build/icons.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux
